name: Core Android Application Container & Manifest Foundation
description: Base Android application host declaring 25 permissions and 147 components (96 activities, 23 services, 21 receivers, 7 providers) hosting Jetpack Compose and Navigation Graph.
behavior_summary: Initializes RootActivity with Jetpack Compose, registers URL deep links (quizlet:// and https://quizlet.com), configures network security, and sets up Dagger/Hilt dependency injection.

reusability_assessment.notes: Architectural reference for modern Android 16 targetSdk container with Compose root navigation.

name: Design System Tokens & Compose UI Theme
description: Comprehensive design system comprising 563 color tokens, typography scales, spacing units, and 328 pure SVG vector icons.
behavior_summary: Provides semantic Indigo/Mint color tokens (#4255FF, #23B26D), Material3 adaptive navigation styling, 3D card flip animation transforms, and dark theme support.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct reference for Family OS education and smart flashcards theme (S5-01).

name: Spaced Repetition & SuperMemo SM-2 Engine
description: Algorithmic spaced repetition memory engine utilizing SuperMemo SM-2, Leitner review boxes, and Ebbinghaus forgetting curve modeling.
behavior_summary: Calculates dynamic Easiness Factor (EF), schedules expanding review intervals (1d, 3d, I_{n-1}*EF), and computes real-time retention probability R = exp(-t/S).

reusability_assessment.notes: Core mathematical engine for Family OS cognitive calendar and exam preparation (S5-01 / S1-06).

name: Adaptive Test Generation & Smart Distractor Engine
description: Assessment generation engine that synthesizes multiple-choice, true/false, matching matrix, and written recall questions with heuristic distractor weighting.
behavior_summary: Evaluates question bank difficulty, matches distractor lengths to prevent visual guessing, and prioritizes concepts where students previously erred.

reusability_assessment.notes: Essential component for school test preparation and automated quiz synthesis in Family OS.

name: Streaks, Streak Freezes & Gamification Engine
description: Micro-habit retention engine tracking daily consecutive study sessions, streak freeze consumable shields, and quadratic XP level progression.
behavior_summary: Calculates local midnight boundaries, awards study activity XP, deducts streak freezes on 1-day lapses, and calculates user level L = floor(sqrt(XP/100)) + 1.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct integration model with Family OS Token Rewards and Screen Time incentives (S1-05).

name: Learning Mastery Tracking & Retention Progress
description: Progress tracking subsystem managing three-state progression (Unseen, Still Learning, Mastered) and weighted set mastery computation.
behavior_summary: Maintains mastery state transitions based on consecutive correct recalls (threshold >= 2), determines due review counts, and outputs set completion percentages.

reusability_assessment.notes: Enables parent dashboard visibility over child study mastery and homework readiness.

name: Offline-First Study & Action Queue Engine
description: Offline-first action buffer capturing study session events, recall outcomes, latency metrics, and star toggles into local persistent SQLite queue.
behavior_summary: Writes discrete study events to offline_action_queue table, prioritizes higher card mastery during offline conflict resolution, and bundles events for upload.

reusability_assessment.notes: Critical for offline school commute study on school buses and offline family travel.

name: Offline Sync & Last-Write-Wins Conflict Resolution Engine
description: Bi-directional cloud synchronization engine resolving data divergence between offline mobile study sets and server state using LWW and mastery preservation.
behavior_summary: Batches pending mutations, performs deterministic Last-Write-Wins (LWW) conflict merging, preserves user local edits, and computes exponential retry delays.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference synchronization architecture for multi-device family data sync.

name: Smart Grading & Arabic Diacritics Normalization Engine
description: Fuzzy text validation engine normalizing Unicode text, stripping Arabic Tashkeel/Tatweel, unifying Alef/Hamza variants, and applying Damerau-Levenshtein tolerance.
behavior_summary: Grades student written answers with semantic leniency, ignoring punctuation, case, and minor spelling slips while penalizing conceptual errors.

reusability_assessment.notes: Essential for Arabic educational curricula and children learning Arabic vocabulary without typo frustration.

name: Match Game Physics, Tile Grid & Scoring Engine
description: Interactive speed-matching game engine operating a 12-tile randomized grid with tap selection physics, error state feedback, and millisecond stopwatch scoring.
behavior_summary: Manages game lifecycle (READY -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED), validates term-definition tile pairs, applies +1.0s penalty on mismatch, and calculates high-score leaderboard times.

reusability_assessment.notes: Highly engaging gamified study mode for child vocabulary and concept mastery.

name: Text-to-Speech & Hands-Free Audio Playback Engine
description: Multilingual audio synthesis and playback orchestration engine supporting automated language locale detection and structured inter-card pause timing.
behavior_summary: Detects language script from text content, orchestrates alternating speech and configurable silence pauses, and delegates to AudioPlaybackService for background listening.

reusability_assessment.notes: Enables hands-free audio study on walks or before sleep for children and auditory learners.

name: Room Database & Local Structured Schema Architecture
description: Persistence architecture comprising 9 Room SQLite tables, composite performance indices, foreign-key cascade rules, and external BLOB isolation.
behavior_summary: Stores study sets, flashcard terms, SRS mastery states, folders, classes, offline queues, and streaks; isolates binary media to disk files to protect SQLite CursorWindow.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct schema blueprint for Family OS local SQLite / Drift storage layer.

name: Cloud REST API & HTTP Gateways Layer
description: Comprehensive client network layer cataloging 195 unique REST endpoints across 4 base API hosts (v3, v4, Coach AI, WebAPI).
behavior_summary: Coordinates Retrofit/OkHttp requests, handles GZIP compressed payloads, manages authentication bearer tokens, and consumes NDJSON streams for AI Coach.

reusability_assessment.notes: Contract model for cloud study set synchronization and streaming AI tutor interactions.

name: CameraX Document Scanner & Native OCR Preprocessing Core
description: Document digitization subsystem integrating AndroidX CameraX with native JNI library libimage_processing_util_jni.so for hardware-accelerated image conversion.
behavior_summary: Converts YUV420 camera preview frames directly to Bitmaps in native C++ memory without GC allocation, facilitating instant OCR document scanning into flashcards.

reusability_assessment.notes: High-speed document scanner for digitizing physical school worksheets and book pages.

name: Approov Mobile App Attestation & Anti-Scraping Security
description: Cryptographic client integrity subsystem utilizing Approov SDK in libapproov.so to verify device attestation and prevent unauthorized API scraping.
behavior_summary: Calculates binary memory hashes to detect Frida/Xposed hooks, signs outbound HTTPS requests with dynamic Approov-Token JWTs, and enforces API gateway authentication.

reusability_assessment.notes: Security pattern for safeguarding proprietary family educational models and API endpoints.

name: Realtime Classroom Competitions & Quizlet Live Protocol
description: Multi-player real-time gamification protocol enabling synchronized team quiz competitions via bi-directional WebSocket messaging.
behavior_summary: Handles 6-digit game PIN join handshakes, distributes complementary question-answer sets across team members, and broadcasts live leaderboard race state.

reusability_assessment.notes: Model for Family Quiz Night and sibling friendly study challenges.

name: Textbook Explanations & Step-by-Step Solutions Architecture
description: Curriculum-aligned textbook solution viewer indexing millions of exercise problems by ISBN and rendering verified step-by-step mathematical explanations.
behavior_summary: Queries textbook metadata by ISBN, fetches chapter problem trees, renders LaTeX math formulas via KaTeX/MathML, and caches recent exercise solutions.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct reference for Family OS homework assistance and step-by-step problem solver (S5-01).

name: Multi-Provider Authentication & Account Management
description: Identity subsystem supporting federated Single Sign-On (Google, Apple, Facebook), school account integration, COPPA age gating, and OAuth2 session tokens.
behavior_summary: Manages user credential flow, enforces child safety isolation (under-13 COPPA compliant profile), stores auth tokens in EncryptedSharedPreferences, and handles account deletion.

reusability_assessment.notes: Integrates directly with Family OS Unified Family Account & Child Identity (S1-02).

name: WorkManager Background Scheduling & FCM Retention Alerts
description: Background execution and scheduling framework utilizing AndroidX WorkManager and Firebase Cloud Messaging for persistent maintenance and study reminders.
behavior_summary: Schedules periodic LRU cache pruning jobs, drains offline study event queues upon network recovery, and triggers urgent evening streak preservation push notifications.

reusability_assessment.notes: Standard background execution pattern aligned with Android 14+ foreground service and WorkManager constraints.

name: Telemetry, ComScore Metrics & Event Logging Pipeline
description: End-to-end telemetry subsystem collecting student study velocity, response latency, session duration, and retention analytics via native libcomScore.so and Snowplow.
behavior_summary: Batches structured behavioral telemetry events, records card flip timestamps, instruments ComScore audience measurement, and isolates COPPA-restricted child data.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference telemetry schema for privacy-compliant learning analytics in Family OS.
